policy_reasons: HIGH/CRITICAL engineering change requires human review
decisions.reason: The exit remains OPEN through broadcast, permitting concurrent callers to submit duplicate sells. Nonce allocation is also not serialized per chain and wallet.
required_tests: Race two close_position callers and assert exactly one broadcast.
Crash after broadcast but before position update and verify restart reconciliation.
Run concurrent operations for one EVM wallet and verify unique monotonic nonces.
decisions.title: EVM position exits can be submitted more than once

policy_reasons: HIGH/CRITICAL engineering change requires human review
decisions.reason: A successful broadcast followed by receipt timeout loses the transaction hash and records a retry-eligible state, creating duplicate-execution and accounting risk.
required_tests: Simulate send success followed by receipt timeout and assert durable RECONCILING state with the hash.
Restart and reconcile both successful and reverted transactions.
Assert no second execution occurs while an attempt is unresolved.
decisions.title: Ambiguous EVM broadcasts are recorded as rejected and may be retried

policy_reasons: HIGH/CRITICAL engineering change requires human review
decisions.reason: Unlocked CSV read-modify-replace operations allow concurrent redemptions to exceed use limits and permit lost user-setting updates.
required_tests: Synchronize two concurrent redemptions of a one-use code and assert exactly one succeeds.
Exercise concurrent creation and settings updates without lost rows.
Add a multi-process locking test, not only a thread test.
decisions.title: Activation-code use limits are not atomic

policy_reasons: HIGH/CRITICAL engineering change requires human review
decisions.reason: Fee submission is treated as settlement without receipt confirmation or a durable reconciliation lifecycle, allowing reported P&L and on-chain balances to diverge.
required_tests: Cover confirmed, reverted, dropped, timed-out, and failed-before-send fee transfers.
Verify gross P&L, user-net P&L, accrued fees, and paid fees reconcile independently.
Verify restart recovery cannot charge a fee twice.
decisions.title: Profit-share liabilities are booked as paid without confirmation or recovery

decisions.reason: Report rendering performs lifecycle updates and inserts, while cache-cold lookup can increment versions and reset established statuses.
required_tests: Assert repeated report rendering produces no database writes.
Assert restart or cache loss does not change version or status.
Assert a new version is created only when the canonical strategy specification changes.
Add bounded retention or deduplication for decision history.
decisions.title: Read-only Strategy Lab reports mutate lifecycle state and grow the database

decisions.reason: Five-minute matrix jobs perform full checkout and unpinned dependency installation before cheap lane and material-change gates. Disk is already 84.54% used; network measurements are host-wide and cannot be attributed solely to the bot. Infrastructure remains BENCHMARK because trade samples, provider costs, region, and same-workload candidate results are insufficient or unknown.
required_tests: Workflow test proving unchanged reports skip checkout and all package installs.
Workflow test proving disabled lanes create no matrix worker.
Measure per-run downloaded bytes, cache growth, and retained worktrees.
Verify optimization preserves all trading and safety controls.
decisions.title: High-frequency adjudication installs provider CLIs before determining whether work is needed

summary: Accept six independently evidenced findings. Highest risk is duplicate or ambiguously reconciled EVM execution. Any fixes require human review, deterministic tests, protected-path gates, and draft-PR-only handling. Infrastructure conclusion is BENCHMARK because trade and candidate-host evidence is insufficient.
